name: analysis_v3_audio_language_task_probes_v1
principle: Exact MIR probes use task-level ground truth and metrics. They are not graded with semantic usefulness ratings.

exact_mir.prompt: What is the tempo of this passage in BPM? Return one numeric BPM value.
What musical key is supported by this passage? Return tonic and mode, or abstain if it is not established.
Which instruments from the supplied evaluation vocabulary are audible in this passage?
Is there a section boundary inside this passage? If yes, identify its time relative to the passage start in seconds.
For the annotated target melody event, is the next annotated melody pitch higher, lower, or the same?

relational_reasoning.prompt: Which annotated musical event happens first, A or B?
Do the two annotated spans contain the same target pattern or different target patterns?
Is the target pitch in span B higher, lower, or the same as the target pitch in span A?
Is the annotated rhythmic pattern in span B faster, slower, or the same rate as span A?
Are the annotated timbral targets in spans A and B the same or different?

notes: This defines task contracts only. It contains no scores and no synthetic ground truth. Exact thresholds/tolerances must be fixed before running a candidate and recorded with the resulting case manifest.
